name: covenant
description: Covenant - a living intelligence layer for SaaS codebases.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @covenant/api" "npm run dev -w @covenant/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @covenant/shared && npm run build -w @covenant/analyzer && npm run build -w @covenant/api && npm run build -w @covenant/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @covenant/shared && npm run typecheck -w @covenant/analyzer && npm run typecheck -w @covenant/api && npm run typecheck -w @covenant/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @covenant/analyzer && npm run test -w @covenant/api
